input.summary: State an express minimum warranty period and add a repair/replace or refund remedy for the § 16.1 warranties
input.comment: [Playbook] The § 16.1 warranties state no period and carry no remedy, so we add one lettered subsection that fixes an express minimum warranty period (ninety (90) days for reports and thirty (30) days for Services, without cutting back the existing Term-long coverage) and gives repair or replacement or, at our election, a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or reports. This is our fallback position.

ops.text: Warranty Period; Remedy. The warranties in Sections 16.1(A) and (B) shall remain in effect throughout the Term and in any event for not less than ninety (90) days following delivery of each report and thirty (30) days following performance of each Service. For breach of any warranty in this Section 16.1, M&I shall promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Services or reports or, at Customer's election, refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or reports.
